FLASHCARD SET · AGES 3–5

Question Words flashcards — the parent shelf: 16 cards to download and print.

The whole question deck for printing at home: sixteen question word cards for ages three to five, each with its ask-it-tonight tip, its download button and one-tap printing — the library is the parents’ side of the class, so everything happens on this one shelf.

This is the parents’ copy of the Question Words class: all sixteen cards on one shelf, ready to print. You do not need a plan — pick the question your days need most, download the card, and print it full size on A4 or Letter paper. Every card carries its ask-it-tonight tip underneath, so the how-to rides along with the picture, and the print button runs a single card through your printer with nothing else on the page. There are no card pages to hop through: the shelf is the whole set.

The shelf is yours; the lesson is your child’s. The class page at Question Words teaches each question the way a teacher would — the six core questions first, then the ten that grow out of real life — while this wall simply holds the deck for printing. Same cards, two jobs: the lesson lives in the class, the library is where parents print.

THE DECK · 16 QUESTIONS

Every card, its tip, and the buttons.

Download takes the full-size card image; Print runs just that one card through the printer. Nothing opens a new page — the shelf is the whole set.

WHERE TO NEXT

The lesson, the hall, the rest of the library.

The Question Words class · The child’s lesson ↗All the extra classes ↗All flashcard sets ↗

Print a card here, teach the question there: the Question Words class is the lesson side of this deck — one card a week pinned at your child’s eye level, with the words to say and the game to play. Once the deck is up on the fridge, the class page is the manual that makes each card stick.
